messages:
Greg (Acme Inc): Hey team — after the deploy this morning our invoice extraction prompt started returning incorrect total amounts for ~15% of invoices. Same prompt used yesterday, internal evals still show green. Can share sample payload and expected vs actual.

leah-cs: sorry to hear that, tagging ML + eng. Do you have a reproducible request/response we can look at?

Greg (Acme Inc): posted one here: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-model-3b-quant-v2\",
  \"prompt\": \"Extract invoice total from text:\nInvoice# 12345\nTotal: $1,234.56\nPlease return only the total.\"
}
```
Response we get: `Total: 1234` (no cents, sometimes missing dollar sign). Expected: `$1,234.56`. Happens only on invoices with comma thousands separators or invoices that have a trailing note line.

vedant-ml: thanks — initial hypotheses: 1) tokenization change with quantized kernels affecting comma/decimal tokens, 2) new destination routing to a smaller variant for some requests, 3) system prompt stripping. Can you confirm exact request headers (model id + x-redwood-route)?

Greg (Acme Inc): header: `x-redwood-route: canary-3b` and model header shows `redwood-model-3b-quant-v2`. No system messages set client-side.

emma-eng: we rolled canary-3b to 10% traffic at 09:12 UTC. Canary uses quant-v2 packing that changed our tokenizer sticky behavior last week in bench runs, but internal synthetics didn't show this reg.

vedant-ml: hmm. Can you paste the raw tokens from the failing request? If the comma is being merged with number tokens that could explain dropped cents. If not, maybe post-processing regex misfire.

Greg (Acme Inc): raw text attached (pasting): `Total: $1,234.56\nNote: paid via ACH` — when Note present we see cents drop. When Note absent it works.

emma-eng: reproducing locally with the same model variant... getting `Total: 1234` as Greg reported. Looks like the model sometimes outputs a trailing `.` which our post-parser strips thinking it's thousands separator. Example completion: `Total: 1,234.56.` -> post-parser regex `\b(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)(?:\.\d{2})?\b` is greedy and may capture `1,234` if period at end breaks group.

leah-cs: wow — so internal evals didn't catch this because our test set didn't include note lines after the total. Customer prompt includes trailing context.

vedant-ml: two action items: (A) quick fix in post-processing to accept trailing punctuation and capture cents — deployable by ops, (B) add dataset variants with trailing notes to eval harness to avoid regression. Also investigate whether tokenizer change increases probability of putting a trailing `.` after the cents.

jon-ops: I can push a post-parse patch to the parsing service in staging now. Small regex change to allow optional trailing punctuation and to prefer cents when present. Rolling to prod once verified. ETA ~30m.

sre-bot: deploy job started: patch/regex-allow-trailing-punct -> staging. CI tests: 12/12 passed.

emma-eng: vedant, can you run a quick A/B on samples with and without trailing note to see if model outputs extra `.` more frequently after canary rollout? If yes, we may need a rollback or traffic shift while we fix tokenization logic.

vedant-ml: running a 500-sample probe now across canary and stable. Preliminary: canary shows trailing-punct completion 6.8% vs stable 0.9%. That's significant. Looks like quant-v2 variant increases that behavior on examples with trailing context.

leah-cs: Greg — we'll push the parse fix to prod and follow up with a patch to evals and a postmortem. Sorry for the disruption.

Greg (Acme Inc): thanks, appreciate the quick triage. Please keep me posted, this affects daily billing runs.

jon-ops: staging tests good, deploying to prod now. Will monitor error rate and run through regression suite.

sre-bot: deploy job completed: patch/regex-allow-trailing-punct -> prod. Monitoring for 30m.

emma-eng: following up on root cause: quant-v2 packing changes token boundaries for `,` and `.` on certain sequences when context extends past the number. We'll add targeted unit tests and a small model-profile rollback plan if customers still see issues.

vedant-ml: filing eval ticket to add trailing-context variants + include the customer's real example (anonymized). Also creating a canary metric to track trailing punctuation completions on number-extraction tasks.

leah-cs: thanks everyone. Greg, we'll send a short incident summary and ETA for longer-term fix (tokenizer/model calibration) once vetting is done.

Greg (Acme Inc): got it — thanks for the quick patch. Will validate on our side and report back within the hour.
